import openpyxl
from openpyxl.utils import range_boundaries
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/56637/1_56637_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/56637_0_2e4db5b2/1_56637_output.xlsx")

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Ensure formulas recalculate when opened
wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"

# Populate only the allowed answer-position cells.
# These formulas auto-update when B5 changes:
# - Rows 12:60 represent 1st Shift positions
# - Rows 61:110 represent 2nd Shift positions
# - ROUNDUP handles fractional staffing requirements from the call-in factor
for row in range(12, 111):
    if row <= 60:
        ws[f"B{row}"] = '=IF(ROW()-ROW($B$12)+1<=ROUNDUP($B$5,0),1,"")'
    else:
        ws[f"B{row}"] = '=IF(ROW()-ROW($B$61)+1<=ROUNDUP($B$5,0),2,"")'

# Also fill the additional exact answer-position ranges, referencing B5 as requested.
for cell_range in ["C12:C23", "D12:H18"]:
    min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(cell_range)
    for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
        for col in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
            cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
            cell.value = '=IF(ROW()-ROW($B$12)+1<=ROUNDUP($B$5,0),1,"")'

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
